missing: Howrah Bridge and the Kolkata station nights (Saroo alone in Calcutta)

Google Earth search with the maps on the wall (Melbourne flat)
Sue Brierley telling Saroo why she adopted (Hobart)

Swap 'Remember 3. Sue and John Brierley, who adopt Saroo' for 'Sheru means lion'
